meta.title: Kisan Mitra · The Operating System for Rural India
meta.description: Kisan Mitra is India's rural operating system — an integrated ecosystem connecting villages with technology, infrastructure, farmer services, leadership and sustainable growth.

hero.kickerLeftTail: The Operating System for Rural India
hero.body: An integrated ecosystem empowering villages with technology, infrastructure, farmer services, leadership and sustainable growth — designed with the dignity of Bharat at its heart.

ecosystem.label: Why Bharat Now
ecosystem.title: Six hundred thousand villages.
ecosystem.body: The villages of India hold 65% of our people, 90% of our food, and the soul of a civilization. They have never lacked talent — only infrastructure to express it. Kisan Mitra is that infrastructure.

story1.title: A farmer wakes before sunrise — and still finishes the day uncertain.
story1.body: Soil he cannot test. Water he cannot store. Markets that pay him last. This is the inheritance of 120 million Indian farmers. We did not inherit it. We choose to end it.
bullets: ₹27,000 average annual income per farming household
Only 9% of villages with cold-chain access

story2.title: A village that thinks, earns & thrives — as one.

story3.title: Technology, infrastructure & leadership — woven together at panchayat scale.
story3.body: Kisan Mitra is not an app. It is a stack — soil intelligence, water plants, solar grids, cold storage, micro-mandis, and trained officers — operated together by the villages themselves.

ruralOs.label: The Rural OS
ruralOs.title: Ten interconnected pillars,
ruralOs.body: Every node strengthens the next. A farmer logs soil — the marketplace forecasts harvest — the cold chain reserves a slot — the mall prices supplies — the officer schedules a pickup. One ecosystem, ten heartbeats.

services.label: Farmer Services
services.title: Ten services.
services.body: Every Mitra member receives access to the full stack of services — priced fairly, delivered locally, and paid only at harvest.

items.d: Hyper-local soil sampling, nutrient mapping & AI-driven crop recommendations — refreshed every season.
Drip & micro-irrigation engineered for your land, powered by solar — and managed by your VLE.
Direct buyer access without middlemen, transparent grade-based pricing, pickup at your gate.
PM-KISAN, MSP, subsidies — applied, tracked and disbursed by your village officer.
Credit pre-approved on your harvest pipeline — fair rates, no paperwork queues.
On-demand tractors, harvesters & rotavators — booked from the mall, priced by the hour.
Precision spraying, crop scouting and yield estimation — operated by certified rural pilots.
Roof, pump & community-grid solar — installed, maintained, financed under one window.
Climate-controlled warehouses & cold rooms close to your village — no more distress sales.
Veterinary on-call, dairy collection, feed quality testing — for every household.

membership.label: Membership
membership.title: Not a subscription.
membership.body: A premium identity card that opens access to every service, every discount, every officer in the network. Pay-at-harvest. Renewable every Kharif. Honoured everywhere.

tiers.desc: Foundational membership for smallholder farms (<1 ha).
For growing households (1–3 ha). Most popular tier.
For large holdings & FPOs (3+ ha). Concierge tier.

infrastructure.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure.title: The hardware of a
infrastructure.body: Water, energy, storage, processing, logistics — engineered, deployed and maintained by Kisan Mitra. Every village a small civilization.

water.title: Community Water Plants
water.desc: 5,000 L/day per cluster · RO + UV · solar-pumped · operated by the village.

ev.desc: Three-wheel EVs assigned to every cluster — silent, solar-charged, gate-to-gate.

leadership.label: Leadership
leadership.title: A four-tier officer corps —
leadership.body: Recruited from the village, accountable to the village. Every Mitra officer is uniformed, equipped with an EV and a Field Connect tablet — a new authority of dignity.

officers.name: Village Level Entrepreneur
officers.desc: The face of Kisan Mitra in the village. Onboards farmers, manages services, runs the smart office.

officers.name: Village Level Manager
officers.desc: Coordinates VLEs in the cluster, manages infrastructure rollout, audits services.

officers.name: Taluka Level Officer
officers.desc: Owns multi-cluster operations, government liaison, machinery & logistics dispatch.

officers.name: District Level Officer
officers.desc: Strategic command. Owns the district P&L, recruitment, and partnerships.

command.title: A national command center for the village.
command.body: Every officer's movement, every pickup, every grievance — logged on a single map. Live deployment, live impact, live accountability.

recruitment.label: Recruitment
recruitment.title: A village officer's exam,
recruitment.body: AI-proctored, QR-verified, hardware-locked. We borrowed from the country's most secure exam systems and rebuilt them — for the field.

terminal.question: Which deficiency causes interveinal chlorosis in mature mustard leaves?

flow.d: Three-hour proctored exam at the nearest KM terminal.
21-day residential training at the District Hub.
Officer issued uniform, ID card, EV & Field Connect tablet.

onboard.label: Onboarding
onboard.title: Seven steps to become
onboard.body: Designed for thumbs in the field, voices in Hindi, and pride in belonging. No paperwork. No queues. Ten minutes.

step1.title: Tell us who you are.
step1.body: हम आपका सम्मानपूर्वक स्वागत करते हैं। पहले, आपका नाम और संपर्क।

step2.title: Where do you farm?
step2.body: Choose your district, taluka and village. We will assign your VLE.

step4.title: Which services do you need?
step4.body: Select as many as apply. Officers will reach you within 24 hours.

step6.title: Verification & consent.
step6.body: Aadhaar e-KYC, mobile OTP and panchayat record check.

step7.title: Welcome, Mitra.
step7.body: Your passport has been issued. A VLE will reach you within 24 hours. Bharat is proud of you.

mall.label: Mini Mall
mall.title: The Super Mini Mall —
mall.body: Inputs, electronics, dairy, building materials, and the goods that villages have always made. Member-priced. Pay-at-harvest. Stocked weekly by the cluster.

cards.body: Pickles, papads, honey, ghee, hand-woven textiles — produced by the SHGs of your own cluster.

Zero interest on member purchases · automatic settlement at crop pickup.

impact.label: Impact
impact.title: Numbers that

app.title: Argus Field

faq.title: Questions
faq.body: The most common questions we receive at our District Hubs — answered the same way we'd answer in a panchayat meeting.

items.q: Do I need to pay anything upfront?
items.a: No. All Mitra memberships are pay-at-harvest. We deduct dues at the time of your first crop pickup, transparently and only with your consent.

items.q: Is my land record safe with Kisan Mitra?
items.a: Yes. We do not store original land documents. We use one-time verification through your panchayat record, and your data sits in sovereign Indian cloud, encrypted.

items.q: What if there is no officer in my village yet?
items.a: You can still register today. The moment a VLE is posted in your panchayat, your services activate automatically and you are notified in your preferred language.

items.q: How is the crop pickup price decided?
items.a: Grade-based pricing, published transparently every morning at 6 AM on the app. You can choose to accept or reject. Either way, the price is yours to see — not negotiated by middlemen.

items.q: Can I upgrade my membership later?
items.a: Yes. You can move from Chhota → Madhyam → Bada at any time. The pro-rated difference is added to your harvest settlement.

items.q: What languages does the app and officer support?
items.a: Hindi, English and 9 Indic languages — Marathi, Punjabi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Odia.

meta.title: Our Apps · Kisan Mitra
meta.description: The Kisan Mitra family of apps — one app for farmers, and dedicated partner apps for machinery owners, transporters, storage operators and mandi buyers who fulfil their requests.

apps.title: Five Partner Apps.
apps.body: Kisan Mitra is the single app a farmer opens for every service. Behind it sit four dedicated partner apps — for machinery owners, transporters, storage operators and mandi buyers — that receive and fulfil the requests a farmer raises.
apps.heroSubtitle: Different needs. One connected platform — Kisan Mitra.
apps.panelBody: Every app plays a role in building a connected, self-reliant farming ecosystem.
apps.ctaBannerTitle: Be a Part of the Kisan Mitra Ecosystem
apps.ctaBannerBody: Whether you're a farmer, service provider or field partner — there's an app for you.

items.name: Kisan Mitra App
items.description: A single app for smallholder farmers that combines farm-service bookings, crop selling at real mandi prices, land records, a digital wallet and government scheme applications — built around a local VLE relationship, not a self-service-only app.
items.longDescription: Your farm, now in your pocket. From soil to mandi — every service in one app. A Rajesh Kaithwas Foundation initiative built around a simple idea: a smallholder farmer shouldn't need five different apps, or a middleman, to run their farm well.
features: Sell crops at live, transparent mandi prices
Book equipment, transport & storage — no haggling
Your land on record, with live soil readings where installed
A wallet built for a farmer's income pattern
Apply for government schemes you're actually eligible for
A trained VLE in your own village

faq.q: Does the app work without internet?
faq.a: Key screens are designed to stay usable on patchy rural networks; features that need a live server response (like mandi price submission) sync as soon as signal returns.

faq.q: Is there a fee to join?
faq.a: Downloading and registering is free. Membership is a separate paid plan, priced per hectare of your approved land, purchased from your in-app wallet — it unlocks discounts and priority on services.

faq.q: Who surveys my land?
faq.a: A trained VLE (Village Level Entrepreneur) in your area conducts the survey. Once approved, your plot's area, documents and status are visible in My Land.

faq.q: How do I know the mandi price is real?
faq.a: Prices are published per region and the app always shows which level — village, taluka or district — a price applies to, rather than implying false village-level precision.

benefits.d: Sell at published rates for your own village, taluka or district — never a guess.
Request equipment, transport or storage — the app broadcasts it to nearby providers and connects you the moment one accepts.
Once a VLE surveys your plot, see its area, documents, approval status and live soil readings where a sensor is installed.

benefits.t: A wallet built for your income
benefits.d: Track earnings, see savings the app has generated for you, and manage a bank account for withdrawal.
Eligibility is computed from your own land, age, gender, crop and locality — apply and track status end to end.

benefits.t: A human helper in your village
benefits.d: Kisan Mitra connects every farmer to a trained local VLE for guidance on loans, insurance and government schemes.

items.d: Aadhaar and PAN-based identity verification as part of registration.
A paid plan priced per hectare of your approved land, purchased from your wallet — unlocks discounts, free-service counts, rate bonuses on crop sales and priority.
Live crop prices for your own village, taluka or district — the section stays hidden rather than showing a fake price where none exists.
Request tractors and other equipment by job and schedule; the app broadcasts your request to nearby owners and connects you the moment one accepts.
Submit a sell request against the live mandi rate — price and amount are always computed by the server, never entered by hand.
Book storage and warehousing the same way, with tracked in-transit, stored and withdrawn status.
The same request-and-match flow, for moving goods.
View your surveyed plots — area, ownership type, documents and approval status. Request a VLE survey for land that isn't recorded yet.
Where a sensor is physically installed, see live moisture, temperature, pH, nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium readings.
Browse schemes with eligibility computed live from your land, age, gender, crop and locality. Apply, attach documents, and track status from submitted through to disbursed.
A real balance, full transaction history, and a personal QR code for identification.
A server-calculated summary of how much the app has saved you across equipment, storage, transport, labour and lab testing over a chosen period.
Register for local events — with instant wallet debit for paid ones — and see real notices posted by field staff.
Browse pilgrimage and trip packages, book for multiple passengers, and cancel under a tiered refund policy.
A real inbox for account and service updates, with unread counts and mark-as-read.

journey.s: Your farm, now in your pocket
journey.d: From soil to mandi — every service in one app. A Rajesh Kaithwas Foundation initiative.
Order inputs, sell crops at live mandi prices, and rent equipment — from one home screen.
Once surveyed by a VLE, see your plot's area, documents, approval status and live soil readings where installed.
A trained local VLE supports you with loans, insurance and scheme guidance behind the scenes.

helper.title: A trained VLE, working behind the scenes
helper.body: Kisan Mitra connects every farmer to a trained VLE (Village Level Entrepreneur) in their area. VLEs conduct land surveys, help with government scheme applications, and support the services you book on the app — real, on-the-ground work behind every request you raise.

items.name: Machinery Provider App
items.description: An app for individual farm-equipment owners — tractors, harvesters, drones and more — to register their machines, receive real rental requests broadcast from farmer bookings on Kisan Mitra, accept or reject jobs, run the rental with an OTP-secured completion handshake, and get paid into a real in-app wallet.
items.longDescription: The Machinery Provider App turns any farm equipment owner into a rental provider on the Kisan Mitra platform. Real farmer requests are broadcast to you, pricing is calculated transparently by the platform — no haggling — and a secure code-based handshake confirms every job before payment is released to your wallet.
features: Real rental requests from real farmers
List every kind of equipment, fully verified
Platform-computed pricing, no haggling
Fair first-accept system
OTP-secured job completion
One wallet for balance, withdrawals & payments

faq.q: What equipment can I list?
faq.a: Tractor, rotavator, cultivator, seed drill, plough, harvester, thresher, sprayer, agricultural drone, water pump, trolley, or other — each registered and verified independently.

faq.q: Do I set my own rental rate?
faq.a: No — every booking's rate is computed by the platform from its own rate card, so there's no pricing disputes or undercutting on either side.

faq.q: How does drone rental verification work?
faq.a: Agricultural drones require additional documentation — UIN number, DGCA certificate and pilot licence — reflecting real regulatory requirements for drone operation.

faq.q: How do I know a job is genuinely finished?
faq.a: A 6-digit code is sent to the farmer and read back to you to confirm the job is done before payment moves — protecting both sides.

benefits.d: Every booking comes from an actual Kisan Mitra farmer's request, broadcast to available equipment owners nearby.
Tractors, rotavators, cultivators, seed drills, ploughs, harvesters, threshers, sprayers, agricultural drones, water pumps, trolleys and more — each independently verified.
Every booking's rate is computed by the platform from its own rate card. You never set, negotiate or send a price.
A 6-digit code is sent to the farmer and read back to you to confirm the job is genuinely done before payment moves.
Real balance, transaction history, bank-verified withdrawals, and QR-based peer payments.

benefits.t: Real support, not a dead end
benefits.d: A genuine complaint/ticketing system and direct contact with your local Kisan Mitra field team.

items.d: A single "Accept bookings" switch on Home controls whether you receive new requests at all.
Incoming rental requests appear on the Home dashboard; accept or reject (with a required reason) in one tap.
Register and manage multiple machines across 11 types. Each machine is independently document-verified — drones specifically collect UIN number, DGCA certificate and pilot licence.
Set each machine's status to Available, Maintenance or Inactive; "Busy" is set automatically whenever that machine is actively on a job.
Bookings move through Requested, Accepted, In Progress and Completed (or Cancelled), tracked with a timeline on the Booking Detail screen.
Starting a job requires tapping "Start job"; completing it requires entering a 6-digit code the farmer reads aloud to you.
Every booking's rate — hourly, daily, per-bigha or per-acre — is calculated by the platform's own rate card, never entered or negotiated by the owner.
Real balance and full transaction history, bank-account-linked withdrawals, QR-code peer transfers, and a 6-digit transaction PIN for security.
Request a withdrawal once your bank account is verified; approved requests settle in 1–2 working days.
Week, month and year views — total earned, number of bookings, average per booking, and busiest day.
Real contacts for your local Village Level Executive, Village Level Manager, Taluka Extension Officer and District Level Officer, with call/message actions.
A formal ticketing system with category, priority, status tracking and escalation — real issue resolution, not a black hole.

items.name: Logistic and Transport App
items.description: A driver and vehicle-owner app that receives real transport job requests generated when farmers book transportation in the Kisan Mitra app — accept or reject jobs, manage your vehicle fleet, run pickup-to-delivery trips with OTP confirmation, and get paid straight to your wallet.
items.longDescription: The Logistic and Transport App connects individual transport owner-drivers directly to real farmer transport requests from the Kisan Mitra platform — no negotiating, no middlemen for job-finding. Jobs broadcast to nearby drivers, the fare is calculated transparently by the system before you accept, and payment lands in your wallet the moment delivery is confirmed.
features: Real jobs from real Kisan Mitra farmers
Transparent, system-calculated fares
One-tap accept, no bidding wars
OTP-confirmed pickup and delivery
Get paid straight to your wallet
Available in English, Hindi and Marathi

faq.q: How do I know a job is genuine?
faq.a: Every trip request comes from an actual Kisan Mitra farmer booking — the app tags the requester as a "Kisan Mitra member" on the request screen, not test or demo data.

faq.q: Does the app track my live location on a map?
faq.a: The in-trip screen shows your route step-by-step, but there's no live GPS map tracking today — that's on the roadmap. You always confirm pickup and delivery with an OTP read aloud by the farmer instead.

faq.q: How am I rated?
faq.a: There's no rating system yet — the app honestly shows "No ratings yet" rather than a made-up number.

faq.q: Is there a fee to withdraw my earnings?
faq.a: No processing fee. Withdrawals are reviewed and typically paid out within 24 hours to 1–2 working days to your verified bank account.

benefits.d: Every trip request comes from an actual Kisan Mitra farmer booking — the app tags the requester as a "Kisan Mitra member."
See the full fare breakdown — base, distance, quantity and loading, with a guaranteed minimum — before you accept. Never negotiate.
Jobs broadcast to available drivers; the first to accept gets it.
Register and manage multiple vehicles — tractor-trolley, tempo, mini-truck, pickup van and more — each with document verification.

benefits.t: Get paid straight to your wallet
benefits.d: Payment is credited automatically the moment delivery is confirmed by OTP, with no processing fee on withdrawal.
A simple online/offline toggle controls whether you receive new job offers.

items.d: One switch controls whether you're receiving new job offers. Requires your KYC to be approved first.
An auto-refreshing job feed shows incoming trip requests with pickup/drop, crop and quantity. Accept or reject with one tap — a rejection needs a reason and the job stays open for other drivers.
Register and manage multiple vehicles — tractor-trolley, tempo, mini-truck, pickup van or other. Each has its own RC, insurance and permit document upload, with a verification status.
Each trip moves through: going to pickup, reached farm, loaded, in transit, delivered. Both pickup and delivery are confirmed by an OTP read aloud by the farmer.
Active trip tracking plus a full history screen with date-range filtering.
Every fare — base, distance, quantity and loading, plus a minimum-fare floor — is calculated by the platform, never entered by the driver.
Real balance, held amount and available amount, with full transaction history. Payment is credited automatically on delivery confirmation.
Add a bank account for verification; once verified, request withdrawals with no processing fee, typically paid out within 24 hours to 1–2 working days.
Week, month and year views — total earned, number of trips, average per trip and busiest day, built from your actual completed trips.
A real notification inbox with All / Requests / Payments / System filters and mark-all-read.
A real support-ticket system for raising and tracking issues — a genuine help channel, not a dead-end contact list.

items.name: Storage Provider App
items.for: Cold storage, godown & open yard owners
items.description: An app for storage facility owners — cold storage, covered godowns, open yards — to register their facilities, receive real farmer storage requests, manage goods coming in and going out (including partial withdrawals) with OTP-secured gate handling, and get paid through a real wallet, with pricing set entirely by the platform.
items.longDescription: The Storage Provider App connects storage facility owners directly to real farmer storage requests — transparent, platform-set pricing that runs as a daily accrual for as long as the produce stays, OTP-secured gate-in/gate-out with full movement history, and support for partial withdrawal so a farmer can take out part of their stock now and the rest later, all tracked accurately.
features: Real storage requests from real farmers
List multiple facilities, every storage type
Transparent, platform-set pricing
Full visibility into every quintal
Partial withdrawal, properly handled
Secure, OTP-confirmed gate handovers

faq.q: Can I list multiple facilities?
faq.a: Yes, register more than one storage unit under a single account — each is independently verified.

faq.q: Do I set my own storage rate?
faq.a: No — a per-quintal-per-day rate card is applied automatically by the platform, so there's never a pricing dispute.

faq.q: Can a farmer collect their stock in parts?
faq.a: Yes — partial withdrawal is fully supported. A farmer can take out part of their stored quantity now and the rest later; every gate-in and gate-out is logged with its own history.

faq.q: Can I extend an active booking?
faq.a: Not yet — that capability isn't available today. Storage billing runs as a daily accrual for as long as produce stays, until it's fully withdrawn.

benefits.d: Every booking request comes from an actual farmer's storage need on Kisan Mitra.
Cold Storage for fruits and vegetables, Covered Godown for grains and dry crop, and Open Yard for bales and bag stacks.
You don't set or negotiate rates — a per-quintal-per-day rate card is applied automatically, so there's never a pricing dispute.
Capacity, occupied space and available space are always accurate and server-calculated — never a number you have to track yourself.
A farmer can collect part of their stored produce now and the rest later; every gate-in and gate-out is logged in full history.
Both check-in and check-out are confirmed with a code the farmer reads out to you, protecting both sides.

items.d: See total capacity, available space, reserved space and filled space — all calculated by the platform in real time.
Booking requests broadcast to you; accept or reject on a first-owner-to-accept basis, with today's expected arrivals front and centre.
Register and manage multiple storage facilities; each goes through its own independent verification.
When produce arrives, confirm with a farmer OTP, then log quantity, lot number, sack count, moisture %, vehicle number and photos. This starts the storage rent clock.
Release produce fully or partially, confirmed again with a farmer OTP. The system determines whether the booking is complete or still partially active.
A live, day-by-day accruing cost figure for each active booking, finalized only once the produce is fully withdrawn.
Bookings organized into New Requests, Upcoming, Active and Completed tabs, so you always know where every lot stands.
Generate a receipt for a stored lot, giving farmers proper documentation of their stored produce.
Real balance, held amount and transaction history, tracked accurately and securely.
Look up another wallet and transfer funds directly, protected by a separate transaction PIN.
Add and verify a bank account for real payouts, subject to platform limits and an optional processing fee.
Real contact details for your local Village Level Executive and Village Level Manager.
A real, tracked support-ticket system for genuine issue resolution.

items.name: Mandi Buyers App
items.tagline: Buy fresh produce directly from the mandi
items.description: A procurement app for mandi and wholesale crop buyers — trading firms and licensed buyers — to receive real farmer crop-lot listings, accept and weigh purchases, settle payment through a real wallet, and track mandi prices, all connected to the same backend the farmer-facing Kisan Mitra app runs on.
items.longDescription: The Mandi Buyers App connects licensed trading buyers directly to real farmer crop listings — no middlemen for discovery, transparent region-resolved mandi pricing, and a secure accept, weigh, confirm purchase flow settled through a real digital wallet.
features: Real crop listings from real farmers
Transparent, region-resolved mandi pricing
Fair first-accept system
Secure, OTP-confirmed settlement
A real wallet built for trading
Full GST, PAN & Aadhaar-backed verification

faq.q: Who can register as a buyer?
faq.a: This is a trade/business tool for trading firms and licensed buyers — registration requires a trader/firm name and GST or license number, not an individual shopper account.

faq.q: Can I set or negotiate the crop price?
faq.a: No — mandi prices are published by the platform and always labelled with the region level they apply to. Buyers view real published rates and accept lots, rather than publishing or negotiating a price.

faq.q: Can I reject a crop lot?
faq.a: There's no explicit reject action — you accept the lots you want, and any lot you don't accept simply passes to another buyer.

faq.q: How is a deal confirmed?
faq.a: At the point of weighing, you record the actual quantity; the farmer reads out a confirmation code which you enter to finalize and settle the deal.

benefits.t: Real crop listings from real farmers
benefits.d: Every "sell request" you see is an actual farmer's crop lot, broadcast to buyers in range.
Live prices resolved to the correct region level — locality, taluka, district or division — always disclosed so you know exactly what area a price applies to.
New lots broadcast to buyers; the first to accept secures the deal.
The farmer reads out a confirmation code at the point of weighing, so payment only releases once both sides agree the deal is done.

benefits.t: A real wallet built for trading
benefits.d: Balance, held amount, transaction history, bank-linked withdrawals, and buyer-specific deposit and top-up.
GST/license, PAN and Aadhaar-backed registration builds trust in the marketplace.

items.d: Toggle "Buying: ON" to start receiving new crop-lot requests.
Farmer-listed crop lots broadcast to buyers; accept the ones you want on a first-accept basis.
Track accepted lots through New, Locked, Done and Cancelled — accepted, weighed, confirmed and completed.
At the point of physical weighing, record the real quantity; enter the farmer's confirmation code to finalize and settle the deal.
A live crop price feed with historical trend data, resolved to the correct region level and always labelled with which level a price applies to.
Real balance, held amount locked against accepted-but-unsettled lots, transaction history, and bank-account linking with passbook verification.
A buyer-specific deposit flow to fund your wallet ahead of purchases.
Upload and manage GST license, PAN and Aadhaar documents for account verification.
A real, ticket-tracked complaint and support system.
Contacts for your local Village Level Executive and Village Level Manager, with call and message actions.

items.name: Labor (Manpower) Provider App
items.description: Manages the labor contractor and worker pool for field work — sowing, harvesting, mandi loading. Matches a farmer's manpower request with available workers.
items.longDescription: The Labor (Manpower) Provider App connects labor contractors and workers directly to real farmer manpower requests raised in Kisan Mitra — for sowing, harvesting, mandi loading and other field work — matching demand with an available worker pool.

moreItems.name: SuperMart Billing / POS Terminal App
moreItems.description: Runs at the counter of the Super Mini Mall — bills a farmer's marketplace order, decreases stock, applies membership discounts, and generates the payment/invoice. The store-level backend behind the farmer's Marketplace.

moreItems.name: Cattle / Crop / Human Doctor Provider App
moreItems.description: One app for all three kinds of doctors. When a farmer books an appointment in Crop Doctor, Pashudhan-Vet or Healthcare, the doctor sees the case here, schedules a video call or visit, and sends back the report or prescription.

apps.fieldOpsSubtitle: The internal apps that keep every VLE, VLM and district officer connected to the field.

fieldOpsItems.name: Staff App
fieldOpsItems.description: The command center for Taluka/District officers — an aggregated dashboard of every VLE/VLM, order, revenue, complaint and inventory item, where targets are set and performance is monitored. It's also the daily-work reporting tool for the Village Level Entrepreneur/Manager (the "My Helper" the farmer sees), and the offline-first field tool used on-site for soil/water sampling, KYC verification, and photo/GPS capture.
